description: Shared schema-17 practice-authoring validation contract (OFFLINE-03b r7). Each runner builds a fresh database from the registered migrations, applies `baseline` then a case's `sql`, closes and reopens the database (so writable_schema edits take effect), and runs its validator. Native: crate::backup::verify_schema_17_practice_authoring_semantics. Browser/Node: validatePracticeAuthoringState (src/data/practiceStateValidation.ts). Both must return the same accept/refuse outcome for every case. The baseline was generated once by running the TypeScript authoring engine (executePracticeAuthoring through createNodeSqliteDatabase) with fixed UUID v4 literals and dumping every affected row: mat-a create then edit carrying the exact retirement record (one history row, two receipts, an instructor origin), mat-b create then remove (its version pruned while its receipt and history row remain). Every value is synthetic. SKIPPED ON PURPOSE: the unknown-action refusal in the receipts loop cannot be reached from a case — migration 0017 declares practice_save_operations.action with CHECK (action IN ('create','edit','correct','regenerate','restore','remove')), so SQLite itself refuses such a row before the validator ever sees it; editing that CHECK through writable_schema is refused earlier still by the CHECK-contract comparison. No case can isolate that branch.
